item.title: Grades for every team eliminated from the World Cu...
item.description:
A World Cup of Unfulfilled Dreams

The 2023 World Cup has been a rollercoaster ride of emotions, with teams from all corners of the globe vying for their place in the coveted tournament. As the final whistle blows, 47 teams will be left to ponder what could have been, their dreams of lifting the coveted trophy shattered. In a bid to provide a comprehensive assessment of every team’s performance, we’ve graded each of the eliminated teams on how their run compared to expectations.
